def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.launch_wave_tail_fraction * w[0]
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[1]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[2]
    s = s + np.log2(f.pipeline_depth_time_ratio) * w[3]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.input_load_coalescing_pressure) * w[4]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.output_store_coalescing_pressure) * w[5]
        s = s + (f.a_refetch_bw_demand + f.b_refetch_bw_demand) * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[7]
        s = s + p.alignment_transaction_penalty * (np.log2(1.0 + f.input_load_coalescing_pressure) + np.log2(1.0 + f.output_store_coalescing_pressure)) * w[6]
    else:
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[8]
        s = s + f.shared_memory_pressure * w[9]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.maximum(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[0]
    s = s + f.instruction_amortization_density * w[1]
    s = s + np.where(f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
                     np.log2(1.0 + f.mainloop_barrier_count) * w[2],
                     np.log2(1.0 + f.mainloop_barrier_count) * w[3])
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        pass
    else:
        s = s + f.occupancy_deficit * w[4]
    if p.alignment_traffic_deficit > 0.0:
        pass
    else:
        pass
    if p.pipeline_latency_occupancy_time_ratio < 4000.0:
        s = s + np.where(f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
                         f.cta_register_file_pressure,
                         f.multistage_stage_depth_exposure) * w[5]
        s = s + np.where(f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
                         f.cta_shared_memory_pressure,
                         f.cta_register_file_pressure) * w[6]
    else:
        s = s + np.where(f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
                         f.cta_register_file_pressure,
                         f.multistage_stage_depth_exposure) * w[7]
        s = s + np.where(f.tm_regstaged > 0.5,
                         f.cta_shared_memory_pressure,
                         f.cta_register_file_pressure) * w[8]
    return s

def score(f, p, hw, w):
    sm = np.fmax(f.tm_crit_ratio, f.tm_l2_ratio)
    t = np.sqrt(np.square(sm) + np.square(f.tm_dram_ratio))
    s = 10.0 * np.log2(t)
    s = s + np.log2(f.operand_panel_transaction_amplification) * w[0]
    s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.barrier_arrival_density) * w[1]
    if p.roofline_ratio < 1.0:
        s = s + f.cta_wave_tail_deficit * w[2]
    else:
        s = s + f.tm_cta_warps * w[3]
        s = s + f.register_file_pressure * w[4]
    if p.output_parallelism_deficit > 0.0001:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[5]
        s = s + f.splitk_sm_latency_rounds_log * w[6]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_roofline_log_time) * w[7]
    else:
        s = s + f.splitk_excess_log * w[8]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_roofline_log_time) * w[9]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.splitk_partial_bytes_ratio) * w[10]
    if p.l2_working_set_pressure >= 1.0:
        s = s + np.fmin(
            np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_hz_ratio + f.a_refetch_bw_demand),
            np.log2(1.0 + f.dram_w1_id_ratio + f.b_refetch_bw_demand)
        ) * w[11]
        s = s + f.log_roofline_time_mraster * w[12]
        s = s + np.log2(1.0 + f.raster_band_l2_pressure) * w[13]
    return s
